Lena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on regional prewarm + autoscaler behavior. Can someone spell out: (A) what triggers prewarm vs autoscale, (B) the failover order if a region hits a procurement delay, and (C) a one-line customer blurb we can paste in PM/CS updates?

Omar: Short answers: (A) prewarm is proactive short-window warming driven by forecasted interactive traffic patterns (keeps KV/cache + small allocations for minutes). Autoscaler reacts to sustained utilization and provisions nodes (takes longer). (B) Failover order is: prewarm -> quantized routing -> burst-bucket remap -> adjacent-region spill -> contract escalation. (C) Blurb below.

Grace: Ops nuance: prewarm uses lightweight kernels and keeps KV caches ready; autoscaler spins up full nodes and restores cache from prefix. Prewarm TTLs are ~3-8 minutes by default; burst buckets are pinned until remapped.

Victor: Customer impact note for PMs: expected latency deltas (p99 approximations): prewarm exhaustion -> +30-150ms; quantized routing -> +50-250ms (quality-validated variants only); remapped burst -> +80-300ms depending on distance; cross-region -> +120-450ms worst-case. We prioritize reserved SLAs so those customers see minimal routing unless explicitly required.

Lena: Omar, can you drop the one-line blurb we can use?

Omar: Copy-paste blurb: "We're proactively hedging regional GPU supply. If a region runs low, we'll route traffic to optimized model variants or nearby capacity to keep responses fast; reserved customers will be prioritized and any temporary latency changes will be small."

Grace: Ops playbook snippet (abridged) for PMs/CS to include in notes — full runbook in Confluence:

```
# abridged fallback flow
if region.prewarm_headroom < 15%:
  notify(#infra-oncall)
  enable_quantized_routing(timeout=3m)
  set_batch_size(policy=small)
  if sustained(duration>=10m):
    remap_reserved_buckets()
    if still_constrained:
      route_to_adjacent_region()
      escalate_contracts()
```

CapacityBot: Runbook published: https://confluence.redwood/infra/regional-fallbacks (page created) :white_check_mark:

Lena: Great, action items: Omar to add the blurb to the all-hands notes, Grace to export reserved/prewarm tag CSV for CS by EOD, Victor to attach the latency matrix to the roadmap doc. I'll coordinate comms once those are done. Thanks! :thumbsup:
